steps.content: [Guest room]

All is silent in the pitch-black night. Schorl remains unresponsive. Fortunately, such advanced technology is beyond the understanding of the people here in Northwild, so you've been able to carry it without raising suspicion.
You sketch several crude plum blossoms in the snow with a twig, each one representing a guest at the manor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The first night, Jiewubei... died in his guest room. His death was gruesome. Killed by a strange poison that made him vomit his guts out.
You draw an X over Jiewubei's plum blossom.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everyone assumed it was the manor master's doing at the time, meant to intimidate the heroes. Who would have thought the real killer was the timid-looking Xu Shen? Xu Shen received a threatening note that night and decided to flee the manor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The next morning, Xu Shen was found buried within the snow guardian lion at the manor's entrance. Everyone thought it was an open provocation from the manor master. Judging from Xu Shen's wounds and the traces around the scene, all evidence pointed to Xiaofeng.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But it was in fact Ma Ling who murdered Xu Shen. She staged the crime scene to frame Xiaofeng, and even made excuses to disperse the group so she could set traps along the route and eliminate them all.
You cross out the plum blossom representing Xu Shen, then turn your gaze toward Ma Ling.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Known as the "General Invincible," Ma Ling always presents herself as bold and chivalrous, so it's shocking that she was capable of such acts. On our way to confront her, we accidentally triggered her traps, which even contained the rare poison "Purple Haze" that was used to murder Jiewubei.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The next morning, when we found Ma Ling, she had already died in her own maze of traps. Based on the time of death, the killer couldn't possibly have been the manor master or Xiaofeng.
You erase Ma Ling's plum blossom and look toward the Immortal Healer, Young Master Brocade, and the Princess.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yin Yansheng is gloomy and eccentric. Shen Wanchou is greedy and cunning. Ji Guining is quietly calculating. If any of them wanted to murder Ma Ling, there's only one motive. To eliminate a competitor so they could be the sole owner of the manor master's codex of Snowquell Arts.

Your gaze finally falls upon the plum blossom representing the manor master. These three murders weren't her doing, but could she have been fanning the flames? And what was her reason for threatening everyone?
With such heavy snow, the mountain path won't be passable anytime soon. You can only leave an offline message on Schorl.

steps.speaker: Communications
steps.content: If contact with Eastia can be established, reinvestigate all related martial clans in Northwild. No one here can be trusted.

The moment the recording stops, a faint rustling sound drifts from the distance, barely perceptible, yet sending chills down your spine. You strain to listen, and the sound seems to be getting closer...
Clap! Someone slaps your back hard!
You startle in alarm, dodging to the side while your hand instinctively moves to your sword hilt. But then you see the person grinning with arms crossed. It's Xiaofeng.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: What are you wasting time on here? I could see that long face of yours from a mile away.
She leans in closer to take a look at the snowy ground in front of you.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oh, making a drawing? Let me see... Wow, you've drawn a... a huge centipede!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...It's a plum blossom. What are you doing in my room?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, we were as close as family just this morning. Don't be so cold. Guess what goodies I brought you?
Before you make a guess, she yanks out a small figure in yellow from behind her.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Shuang'er? I've been looking for you for so long. Where did you run off to?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I... hehe...
Her face is somewhat pale, and she shrinks back behind Xiaofeng guiltily.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Guess where I found her? In the kitchen!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: She was crouching by the stove all by herself, clutching this huge roasted sweet potato and munching away! Caught her red-handed hogging the food.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: After you left me all alone in those traps! I didn't dare move a muscle, waiting for you guys to come rescue me... I waited so long I nearly froze into a snowman!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: That can't be right! I remember I went back specifically to check, but I didn't see you there... Hey, what are you drawing?
Shuang'er starts drawing with a wooden stick next to your plum blossoms.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I'm drawing a big dumb tiger, an awful, ungrateful tiger!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hmph! You're not the only one who knows how to draw!
She shoves Shuang'er aside with her bottom, claiming the spot before lifting her foot to start sketching in the snow.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: I'm drawing a chattering little sparrow getting squashed by the rear of the tiger you're drawing.
When Shuang'er crawls back indignantly to take a look, there's nothing in the snow but footprints.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Where's the sparrow? I need to smudge it!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Haha, I was only pretending. You're so weak and tiny. I don't even bother drawing your little sparrow.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You, you... I, I...!
[Small CG: Trio]
You sigh and step forward to separate the two of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right, tone it down a bit...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're the mountain lord of White Tiger Mountain, after all. Have some dignity and stop bickering with a little girl, will you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, you both drew really well...
Amid the squabble, the tense suspicion and wariness from these past few days somehow seem to be fading.
The bright snow in the courtyard feels serene, and even the howling wind no longer sounds so harsh.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: So, feeling better now?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: About what?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Mm... nothing. As long as you seem fine.
She smiles and gazes toward the far end of the courtyard. Shuang'er has also perked up, bouncing around in the snow and waving at you.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Hey! I built a snowman! Come and look!
When you go over to look, you see only a few lopsided white lumps in the snow, the shapes barely recognizable.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What is this supposed to be?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Can't you tell? But they're so lifelike! Here's a mangy tiger that's as fat as a pig. You're walking her on a leash while I ride on her head. You're looking at Master Shuang'er's trio!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Once we leave this manor, we'll travel all around Eastia like this! So what if we can't become martial arts masters? We'll just set the tiger loose to bite our enemies!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Who needs secret codices or fancy titles? We can still wander the world and help people along the way with our swords!
You stare at the messy pile of snow on the ground wordlessly. Your "young hero" persona is nothing but a false identity. You can't make her such a promise.
But someone else voices an objection before you can.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Not interested. Once I get out of here, I'm going straight back to my den to lounge around, eat meat, and drink wine. I'm done with all this martial world nonsense.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Who says we're taking you? That's Meowy I made.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Then I'm turning down the offer on Meowy's behalf too.
At some point, Xiaofeng has already climbed onto the roof. She scoops up a handful of snow and hurls it down, completely ruining Shuang'er's "masterpiece."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Here we go again.
You sigh as Shuang'er shouts and grabs her wooden stick, chasing after her.
But of course Shuang'er can't catch up with Xiaofeng, who's fast like a gust of wind. She can only stop in the corridor, gasping for air.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You mangy tiger, slow down... Ha... I... I...
Panting, her voice gradually dwindles. Fine beads of cold sweat appear on her forehead, and her body involuntarily hunches over.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: No... I can't go back like this... I'll get noticed...
One hand grips the corridor railing tightly, barely supporting her weakening body, while the other reaches tremulously for the bag at her waist.
But her fingertips won't obey, and several small medicine bottles drop to the ground, rolling away.
She hurriedly bends down to pick them up, but her vision suddenly goes black. It's the residual "Purple Haze" poison in her body. It's flaring up again.

Shuang'er endures the excruciating pain in her internal organs, crouching on the ground and stretching her arm toward the nearest porcelain bottle. Under the moonlight, a rough straw sandal appears suddenly and steps on the bottle.
I never had a chance to take a proper look at you, young miss... Your complexion doesn't seem very healthy, does it?
A gaunt, malevolent face leans down, his viper-like gaze fixed upon her. Shuang'er props herself up and lifts her face, forcing out a cold laugh.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Doctor Yin? I remember... your room is not in this part of the manor, is it?

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Heh, care to guess why this old man would seek you out here? I caught a whiff of medicinal fragrance just now... Century ginseng roots, snowridge lingzhi powder, turtle shell paste...
As he speaks, the renowned healer steps closer and closer.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: How could a little beggar from Ping'an Town possibly come by such precious medicine? Miss Shuang'er, could it be... you have another name you haven't yet told this old man?
The words have barely left his mouth before his walking stick swings toward Shuang'er's head.
